exposure: Concerted action to reduce CS rates
Inclusion of CS rates as a criterion for hospital funding
concerted action to reduce CS rates
Information and training of healthcare professionals
cohort: Births occurring in Portugal between 2000 and 2014
finding: A concerted action to reduce CS rates in Portugal, including information dissemination, healthcare professional training, and hospital funding criteria, was associated with a significant reduction in national CS rates and improvement in most related obstetric indicators.
mod_finding: Rates of instrumental vaginal delivery, VBAC and perineal lacerations increased, while the incidence of hypoxia-related complications decreased.
